charts.title: TOI-6000 b: orbits around TOI-6000
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6000's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6000 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gomez Barrientos et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170..148G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GOMEZ_BARRIENTOS_ET_AL_2025): P 0.448959 d
